###########################################
####### Transformation and BLUPs #######
##########################################

```{r}
## Distribution of the phenotype
long_data_anti_sense <- long_data_anti_sense %>%
  mutate(TE = gsub("_AS$", "", TE))
# TEs unique to each
sense_only_TEs <- setdiff(long_data_sense$TE, long_data_anti_sense$TE)
anti_only_TEs  <- setdiff(long_data_anti_sense$TE, long_data_sense$TE)
# Filter and combine
long_data_combined <- bind_rows(
  long_data_sense %>% filter(TE %in% sense_only_TEs),
  long_data_anti_sense %>% filter(TE %in% anti_only_TEs)
)


## Intersecting tes 
# TEs present in both
shared_TEs <- intersect(long_data_sense$TE, long_data_anti_sense$TE)

long_data_intersecting <- inner_join(
  long_data_sense, 
  long_data_anti_sense, 
  by = c("TE", "sample_id"), 
  suffix = c("_sense", "_anti_sense")  # = not ()
)
```
```{r}
# Transform values 
library(forecast)
long_data_combined <- long_data_combined[long_data_combined$genotype=="ddm1",] # Select only ddm1
long_data_combined_transformed <- long_data_combined %>%  
  group_by(TE, genotype) %>% 
  mutate(
    zscale = (expression_value - mean(expression_value)) / sd(expression_value),
    log2=log2(expression_value+1),
    shifted = expression_value - min(expression_value) + 1,
    lambda = BoxCox.lambda(shifted, lower = -0.5, upper = 0.5)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    boxcox = BoxCox(shifted, lambda[1])
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

##############################
#######Calculate BLUPs #######
##############################
## BLUPs calculation and diagnostics
```{r}
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)

#########################
## Calculate BLUPs with diagnostics
#########################
blups_zscale <- long_data_sense_transformed %>% 
  group_by(TE) %>% 
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lmer(zscale ~ (1 | acc_var) + (1 | replicate) + (1|Sequencing_date), data = .x)),
    blups_zscale = map(model, ~ ranef(.)$acc_var %>% 
                  rownames_to_column("acc_var") %>%
                  rename(BLUP = `(Intercept)`)),
    fitted_resid = map2(model, data, ~ .y %>%
                          mutate(
                            fitted = fitted(.x), # Fitted values from the model 
                            residuals = residuals(.x) # Residuals from the model 
                          ))
  )

# Extract BLUPs for analysis
blups_long <- blups_with_diagnostics %>%
  select(TE, genotype, blups) %>%
  unnest(blups) %>%
  separate(acc_var, into = c("accession", "genotype"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(accession, TE, genotype, BLUP)

# Extract fitted 
fitted_resid_long <- blups_with_diagnostics %>%
  select(TE, genotype, fitted_resid) %>%
  unnest(fitted_resid)
```

```{r}
       y = "Count")

## Mean vs BLUPs 
# Make BLUPs long 

# Calculate mean expression per accession-TE-genotype
mean_expr <- long_data_transformed %>% 
  group_by(accession, TE, genotype) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    expr_mean_transformed = mean(transformed),
    expr_mean_raw = mean(log2(expression_value + 1)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge with BLUPs and annotation 
blups_long$accession <- as.numeric(blups_long$accession)
blups_annot <- left_join(blups_long, te_annotation, by = c("TE" = "Transposon_Name"))
# Merge with mean expr
blups_annot_meanexpr <- left_join(blups_annot,mean_expr, by=c("TE", "accession", "genotype") )
#########################
## BLUPs vs mean within each family 
#########################

correlations <- blups_annot_meanexpr %>%
  group_by(Transposon_Super_Family, genotype) %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(expr_mean_transformed, BLUP, use = "complete.obs"),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View correlations
print(correlations)

# Plot BLUPs vs mean expression
blups_annot_meanexpr %>% 
  filter(genotype %in% c("ddm1")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(expr_mean_transformed, BLUP)) +  # Remove data argument
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  geom_text(data = correlations %>% filter(genotype %in% c("ddm1")),  # Filter correlations too
            aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, 
                label = sprintf("r = %.3f", correlation)),
            hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Transposon_Super_Family + genotype, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "BLUPs vs Mean Expression by Superfamily (transformed)",
       x = "Mean Expression",  # Swapped labels to match axes
       y = "BLUP")

```

### BLUPs visualization###
```{r}
# Pivot to wide format with separate columns for Col and ddm1
blups_col <- blups_annot_meanexpr %>%
  filter(genotype == "Col") %>%
  distinct(accession, TE, BLUP, Transposon_Super_Family, Transposon_Family, expr_mean_transformed, expr_mean_raw) %>%
  rename(BLUP_Col = BLUP,
         expr_transf_Col = expr_mean_transformed,
         expr_raw_Col = expr_mean_raw)

blups_ddm1 <- blups_annot_meanexpr %>%
  filter(genotype == "ddm1") %>%
  distinct(accession, TE, BLUP, Transposon_Super_Family, Transposon_Family, expr_mean_transformed, expr_mean_raw) %>%
  rename(BLUP_ddm1 = BLUP,
         expr_transf_ddm1 = expr_mean_transformed,
         expr_raw_ddm1 = expr_mean_raw)

# Join them together
blups_wide <- blups_col %>%
  inner_join(blups_ddm1, by = c("accession", "TE", "Transposon_Super_Family", "Transposon_Family"))

blups_wide$diff_per_TE_blup <- blups_wide$BLUP_ddm1-blups_wide$BLUP_Col
blups_wide$diff_expr_raw <- blups_wide$expr_raw_ddm1-blups_wide$expr_raw_Col
blups_wide$diff_expr_transf <- blups_wide$expr_transf_ddm1-blups_wide$expr_transf_Col

# Then average per accession-superfamily
blups_superfamily <- blups_wide %>%
  group_by(accession, Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_BLUP_Col = mean(BLUP_Col, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_BLUP_ddm1 = mean(BLUP_ddm1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff = mean(diff_per_TE_blup, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot histograms
ggplot(blups_wide, aes(x = BLUP_Col)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#FFB823", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "BLUPs Col0", x = "BLUPs", y = "Count") +
  facet_wrap(~Transposon_Super_Family, scales="free")

ggplot(blups_wide, aes(x = BLUP_ddm1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "darkblue", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "BLUPs ddm1", x = "BLUPs", y = "Count") +
  facet_wrap(~Transposon_Super_Family,scales="free")

ggplot(blups_wide, aes(x = diff_per_TE)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "darkred", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "BLUPs ddm1 - Col0", x = "BLUPs", y = "Count") +
  facet_wrap(~Transposon_Super_Family,scales="free")


library(tidyr)

blups_long <- blups_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(BLUP_Col, BLUP_ddm1, diff_per_TE),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, 
                          levels = c("BLUP_Col", "BLUP_ddm1", "diff_per_TE"),
                          labels = c("BLUPs Col0", "BLUPs ddm1", "BLUPs ddm1 - Col0")))

ggplot(blups_long, aes(x = value, fill = variable)) +
```

## Heatmap of the differences 
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
# Prepare matrix with TEs as rows, accessions as columns
heatmap_data <- blups_wide %>%
  select(accession, TE, BLUP_ddm1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = accession, values_from = BLUP_ddm1) %>%  # Switch here
  column_to_rownames("TE") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Prepare row annotation (TE superfamily)
te_annotation <- blups_wide %>%
  distinct(TE, Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  arrange(TE)

# Row annotation
# Define 10 distinct colors
superfamily_colors <- c(
  "#E41A1C",  # Red
  "#377EB8",  # Blue
  "#4DAF4A",  # Green
  "#984EA3",  # Purple
  "#FF7F00",  # Orange
  "#FFFF33",  # Yellow
  "#A65628",  # Brown
  "#F781BF",  # Pink
  "#999999",  # Gray
  "#66C2A5"   # Teal
)

# Get unique superfamilies
unique_superfamilies <- unique(te_annotation$Transposon_Super_Family)

# Create named color vector
superfamily_col <- setNames(superfamily_colors[1:length(unique_superfamilies)], 
                            unique_superfamilies)

# Row annotation with custom colors
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Superfamily = te_annotation$Transposon_Super_Family,
  col = list(Superfamily = superfamily_col)
)

# Color function
min_val <- min(heatmap_data, na.rm = TRUE)
max_val <- max(heatmap_data, na.rm = TRUE)

# Symmetric scale around 0
max_abs <- max(abs(min_val), abs(max_val))
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#9BC09C", "white", "#C5172E"))

# Plot
ht <- Heatmap(heatmap_data,
        name = "ddm1-Col",
        col = col_fun,
        right_annotation = row_ha,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_columns = TRUE,
        show_row_names = FALSE,
        show_column_names = TRUE,
        row_km = 3,
        row_km_repeats = 1000,
        column_km_repeats = 1000,
        column_km = 2,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
        column_title = "TE Expression Change (ddm1 - Col)",
        row_title = "TEs")

draw(ht)

# Extract TE clusters
ht_draw <- draw(ht)
row_clusters <- row_order(ht_draw)

# Get cluster assignment for TEs
te_cluster_assignment <- data.frame(
  TE = rownames(heatmap_data),
  cluster = rep(1:3, times = sapply(row_clusters, length))[order(unlist(row_clusters))]
)

head(te_cluster_assignment)
```
## Visualize clusters raw data

```{r}
# Loop through each TE and write to its own folder

unique_TEs <- unique(long_df_final$TE)

long_df_final <- long_df_final %>% ungroup()

    dplyr::filter(te == TE) %>%
    dplyr::select(null1, accession, null2, null3, null4,col_avg,ddm1_avg,ddm1_min_col)

              quote = FALSE,
              sep = "\t",
              row.names = FALSE,
              col.names = FALSE)}
```

## Calculate heritability
```{r}
long_data_transformed$accession<- as.numeric(long_data_transformed$accession)
long_data_transformed$plate<-as.numeric(long_data_transformed$plate)
long_data_transformed$replicate<-as.numeric(long_data_transformed$replicate)
long_data_transformed_j <- left_join(long_data_transformed,sampleData, by=c("accession"="Accession", "plate"="Request_id", "replicate"="Replicate", "genotype"="Variant"))

long_data_transformed_j <- long_data_transformed_j %>%select(TE, accession, plate, Sequencing_date, acc_var, genotype, transformed, replicate, expression_value, boxcox)

heritability <- long_data_transformed_j %>%
  filter(genotype %in% c("ddm1")) %>%
  #na.omit() %>%  # Remove all NAs
  group_by(TE, genotype) %>% # Heritability for each TE within genotype 
  #filter(n() >= 5, n_distinct(acc_var) >= 3) %>%  # Sufficient data
  group_map(~ {
    model <- lmer(log2(expression_value+1) ~ (1|accession) + (1|replicate) + (1|plate), data = .x)
    varcomp <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
    var_acc <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "accession"]
    var_replicate <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "replicate"]
    var_seq_date <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "plate"]
    var_resid <- varcomp$vcov[varcomp$grp == "Residual"]
    h2 <- var_acc / (var_acc + var_replicate + var_seq_date + var_resid)
    # Get residuals
    resid <- residuals(model)
    tibble(
      TE = .y$TE,
      genotype = .y$genotype,
      heritability = h2,
      var_acc = var_acc,
      var_replicate = var_replicate,
      var_seq_date = var_seq_date,
      var_resid = var_resid,
      residuals=list(resid)
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# View results
head(heritability)
```
## Visualize heritability output per family/Superfamily 
```{r}
## Heritability distribution
heritability_with_family <- inner_join(te_annotation,heritability, by=c("Transposon_Name"="TE"))

# Calculate the number of TEs per superfamily and genotype
te_counts <- heritability_with_family %>%
  group_by(genotype, Transposon_Super_Family) %>%
  summarise(n_TEs = n_distinct(Transposon_Name), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Transposon_Super_Family, "\n(n=", n_TEs, ")"))

# Join back to original data
heritability_with_family <- heritability_with_family %>%
  left_join(te_counts, by = c("genotype", "Transposon_Super_Family"))

# Plot with custom labels
ggplot(heritability_with_family, aes(x = heritability, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFB823", "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Heritability per TE", x = "Heritability", y = "Count") + 
  facet_wrap(~genotype + label, scales = "free_y")

## Without labels 
ggplot(heritability_with_family, aes(x = heritability, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFB823", "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Heritability per TE", x = "Heritability", y = "Count") + 
  facet_wrap(~genotype+Transposon_Super_Family,scales = "free_y")

## Residuals distribution 
heritability %>%
  unnest(residuals) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = residuals, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFB823", "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Residuals by Genotype", 
       x = "Residuals", 
       y = "Count")+facet_wrap(~genotype)

#write.table(heritability_with_family, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/04_output/heritability_ind_te.csv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep="\t")
heritability %>%
  unnest(residuals) %>%

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFB823", "darkblue")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Residuals by Genotype", 
       x = "Genotype", 
       y = "Residuals")
```

## Baseline specific
```{r}
baseline_acc <- "6909"

blups_vs_baseline <- blups_wide %>%
  left_join(
    blups_wide %>% 
      filter(accession == baseline_acc) %>%
      select(TE, baseline_BLUP_Col = BLUP_Col, baseline_BLUP_ddm1 = BLUP_ddm1),
    by = "TE"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Relative to baseline
    rel_Col = BLUP_Col - baseline_BLUP_Col,
    rel_ddm1 = BLUP_ddm1 - baseline_BLUP_ddm1,
    # Difference in response
    diff_response = rel_ddm1 - rel_Col
  )
```
